base.description: Pinned baseline: SGLang at the study branch point; NVFP4 MoE on FlashInfer CUTLASS (the tree's auto choice, flashinfer_trtllm, is SM100-only and crashes on SM120); decode CUDA graphs up to bs 32 (the largest gate workload); attention, FP8 KV cache (from the checkpoint) and dense GEMMs on the tree's defaults.

chunk8k.description: T1 (W3): one-chunk W8 prefill. --chunked-prefill-size 8192 so 8x1024 is one chunk; --mem-fraction-static pinned to base's resolved 0.718 so the KV pool does not change with the chunk size.

splits16.description: T2 (W3): Triton decode attention split-KV count 16 (tree default 8).

w32a-mem080.description: T-W32a (gemma4nv-b3-w32a): base plus --mem-fraction-static 0.80, so the KV pools (66k full / 53k sliding tokens) hold W32's 32 x 1152 tokens without retraction; see trials/W32-DIAG.md.

w32b-mem076.description: T-W32b (gemma4nv-b3-w32b, variant of T-W32a): base plus --mem-fraction-static 0.76, the smallest probed fraction whose KV pools (52k full / 41.5k sliding tokens) hold W32 without retraction while leaving 5.2 GB for the teacher-forced logprob peak that OOMed 0.80; see trials/W32-DIAG.md.

smallm-gemm.description: T3 (W6, gemma4nv-b2-t3): base2 (w32b-mem076) on commit 1fd77e64b0 (base a9871012 + Triton small-M BF16 GEMM) with SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_BF16_GEMM=1, routing the decode-M o_proj and dense MLP BF16 linears off cuBLAS's SM80 WMMA fallback; see trials/T3-smallm-bf16-gemm.md.

base2.description: Pinned base2 (W5): base plus T-W32b's --mem-fraction-static 0.76, kept on bs3 (W32 x1.49, W8/W1 neutral, fidelity pass). The KV pools hold W32's 32 x 1152 tokens without retraction and leave room for the teacher-forced logprob peak.

base2-splits16.description: T2 stacked on base2 (W5, variant of the bs2 T2 trial): base2 plus Triton decode attention split-KV count 16 (tree default 8).

smallm-gemm-t3c.description: T3c (W7, gemma4nv-b2-t3c): smallm-gemm (base2 + T3, switch on) on commit 826d472504, whose allowlist adds qkv_proj (sliding and full), the 128-expert router (split-K 8) and the tied lm_head to the Triton small-M BF16 GEMM; see trials/T3c-smallm-qkv-router-lmhead.md.
